title: Catch a Valid/Ready Bug with Assertions
description: Write the valid/ready protocol checks for a one-word register slice (valid hold, payload stable, a bounded-ready assumption and two covers), watch a run without backpressure pass vacuously, then let the checks pinpoint a seeded payload bug and confirm the fix.

steps.title: Step 1: Run the starter and read the scoreboard error
steps.instructions: Read the README sections 'The bench' and 'The rules'. Run the starter (make run SIM=<your simulator>). The given checks a_in_ready_known and a_accept_to_out pass, but the scoreboard reports '[85 ns] [TB] scoreboard: expected a2, got a3' and the bench ends with '[135 ns] [TB] FAIL'. Write down what the scoreboard tells you (a word is wrong) and what it cannot tell you (when and why it went wrong).

steps.title: Step 2: Predict, then write R1 and R2
steps.instructions: Answer the prediction questions in Step 2 of the README first: Q0 (why R0 is a deferred immediate assertion, R2 a concurrent one and the scoreboard check a simple immediate one) and Q1 and Q2 (|-> or |=>). Then, in tb/hs_slice_sva.sv, complete TODO 1 (a_out_valid_hold) and TODO 2 (a_out_data_stable) with @(posedge clk), disable iff (!rst_n), $stable and the message format given in the file. Do not run yet.

steps.title: Step 3: Add the assumption and the covers, then run without stalls
steps.instructions: Complete TODO 3 (m_sink_ready_bounded, an assume property with ##[1:MAX_STALL]) and TODO 4 (covers c_transfer and c_stall_then_ready, each incrementing its counter). Run make nostall SIM=<your simulator>. Expect '[115 ns] [TB] PASS' and a summary with 0 check failures, c_stall_then_ready hit 0 times and c_transfer hit 6 times. Explain why this passing run proves nothing about R1 and R2.

steps.title: Step 4: Run with stalls and read the failure
steps.instructions: Run make run SIM=<your simulator>. Expect exactly one assertion failure, '[75 ns] [SVA] a_out_data_stable: out_data changed from a2 to a3 ...', then the scoreboard error at 85 ns, '[135 ns] [TB] FAIL' and a summary with 1 check failure, c_stall_then_ready hit 1 time and c_transfer hit 6 times. If your output differs, compare it with make solution and use the hints in the README. Answer the Step 4 questions: why 75 ns and not 65 ns, and which design signal must have changed out_data.

steps.title: Step 5: Fix the design and confirm a clean run
steps.instructions: Use the failure to find the bug in rtl/hs_slice.sv and fix it with a one-line change. Rerun make run SIM=<your simulator>: expect '[135 ns] [TB] PASS: 6 words received in order, no assertion failures' and a summary with 0 check failures, c_stall_then_ready hit 1 time and c_transfer hit 6 times. Compare your files with solution/hs_slice.sv and solution/hs_slice_sva.sv (make solution-fixed runs them).
